$$
{A}_{△}=\frac{1}{2}CH\cdot AB
$$

So, to find $CH,$ we first find ${A}_{△}.$ To start, we find the vectors $\overset{\to }{AB}$ and $\overset{\to }{AC}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =b-a \\  & =(-i+4j+k)-(i+j+k) \\  & =-2i+3j \\  & =⟨-2,3,0⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AC} & =c-a \\  & =(2i+k)-(i+j+k) \\  & =i-j \\  & =⟨1,-1,0⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB}\times \overset{\to }{AC} & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -2 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(3\cdot 0-(-1)\cdot 0)i-((-2)\cdot 0-1\cdot 0)j+((-2)\cdot (-1)-1\cdot 3)k \\  & =-k \\  & =⟨0,0,-1⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB}$ and $\overset{\to }{AC}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =|\overset{\to }{AB}\times \overset{\to }{AC}| \\  & =\sqrt{{0}^{2}+{0}^{2}+(-1)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1} \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

The area of the triangle is half of the area of the respective parallelogram. So, the area of $△\,ABC$ is

$$
{A}_{△}=\frac{1}{2}A=\frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}.
$$

Let's also compute $AB$ since it appears in the formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =|\overset{\to }{AB}| \\  & =\sqrt{(-2)^{2}+{3}^{2}+{0}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{13} \\  & =\sqrt{13}.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, using the formula ${A}_{△}=\frac{1}{2}CH\cdot AB,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{△} & =\frac{1}{2}CH\cdot AB \\ \frac{1}{2} & =\frac{1}{2}CH\cdot \sqrt{13} \\ 1 & =CH\cdot \sqrt{13} \\ CH & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{13}} \\ CH & =\frac{\sqrt{13}}{13}.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["7a0bcdee-48c0-51cd-9239-5ca0f8cdfb94"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "58eb9c5b-dc36-5c5a-9c5d-5db3dd5fb2f8" :answer/id #uuid "58eb9c5b-dc36-5c5a-9c5d-5db3dd5fb2f8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3\sqrt{13}}{13}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "0daf3e2b-7bd4-528e-ab6e-ac7f1722d756" :answer-field/id #uuid "0daf3e2b-7bd4-528e-ab6e-ac7f1722d756" :answer-field/key "field-1" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank :answer-field/choices ["58eb9c5b-dc36-5c5a-9c5d-5db3dd5fb2f8"] :answer-field/correct "58eb9c5b-dc36-5c5a-9c5d-5db3dd5fb2f8" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "3c269e70-e4c2-5782-b1f2-15eb40534125" :question/id #uuid "3c269e70-e4c2-5782-b1f2-15eb40534125" :question/problem "Calculate the length of the altitude $CH$ of the $△\,ABC$, if $A(-1,-1,0)$, $B(-3,2,0)$, $C(-2,2,0).$
